** Avatar Companion - 

Players can save a set number of avatar configurations as genetic presets, allowing them to quickly switch between looks at any time. Those with a companion key will be able to assign one of their saved presets as their in-game AI companion. The companion launches as a game AI, with plans to evolve into a more advanced LLM-powered experience over time. Rather than acting independently, the companion works alongside you in the world, helping with things like gathering loot, supporting you in combat, and more.

A quick note on how Starter Bundles work (please read!)

Starter Bundles are our way of letting players get a collection of items at a bulk discount. Better pricing than buying everything individually.

The bundles themselves will always be available in the store. They're a permanent part of the game. What changes is what's inside them.

Think of each bundle as a box. The box is always there, but the items we put in it rotate over time. Once the current items sell out, we swap in new ones for the next round.

So if you want what's in the box right now, this is your window. For example, the Bubblejett Prima 1938 is in the Founder Bundle, but once those 200 are gone, it's gone forever.

Some items are exclusive to a specific bundle rotation and won't come back. Others may appear again in future rotations or be sold individually. We'll always be clear about which is which.

The one exception: the Founder Bundle.

The Founder Bundle is the only bundle that fully retires after its 200 supply is sold. Once those 200 are gone, the Founder Bundle is done.

On top of that, the following perks are exclusive to these 200 Founder Bundles and will never be available again:


Founder Discord Channel
,
Founder Club Access (in-game)
,
Founder Badge
,
Founders of the World Name Engraving
,

These are not rotating. They belong to the 200 Founder Bundle buyers and that's it.

If you want to buy more than one bundle, go for it. Just know that if you purchase multiple bundles from the same account, you'll receive multiple copies of the POA items, but the non-POA perks (badges, Discord channels, IGC, etc.) will only apply once. If you want those perks on more than one account, you'd need to purchase from separate accounts.

Important note on ownership.

Bundles themselves are not Player Owned Assets (POAs). They're just the package. The individual items inside each bundle are the POAs. Those are what you own, and those are what get airdropped to your account as they become game-ready.

One more thing. These first bundles are not just discounted. They're further discounted for our existing community. The prices you're seeing are lower than what future players will ever pay. This is our way of saying thank you to the people who've been here.

TL;DR: Bundles = bulk discount on a collection of items. The bundles are permanent, the items inside them are not. The Founder Bundle is the one exception, it fully retires after 200 are sold, along with its exclusive perks. Bundles are not POAs, the items inside them are. And this first round? You're getting the best deal these bundles will ever have.

---

Glossary

Bundle - A package of items sold together at a bulk discount. Bundles are not POAs. They are just the container. You own the items inside, not the bundle itself.

POA (Player Owned Asset) - An individual in-game item that you own. These are the vehicles, apartments, gear, weapons, and outfits inside each bundle. Only the game assets that are already existing today will be minted at checkout. All other assets will arrive in your wallet as they become available closer to Alpha release.

Exclusive - An item or perk that is tied to a specific bundle and will never be available again once that bundle's supply is sold out. For example, the Bubblejett Prima 1938 is exclusive to the current Founder Bundle. Once those 200 sell, it's gone. No individual sales, no future rotations.

Non-Exclusive - An item that appears in a bundle but also exists in a larger total supply. After the bundle rotation ends, remaining inventory may be sold individually or included in future bundle rotations. (edited)

Round 1 Voting for Zones 4, 5, and 6 is LIVE (OGs + Founders)
,
Round 2 of voting will begin on Monday at 5pm UTC

We’re kicking off early planning for the next set of zones, starting with Founders and OGs.

This first round is limited to Founders and OGs and will carry more weight in the final result. After that, Round 2 will open to the rest of the community.

Even though Zones 2 and 3 are still being built, the reality is that Zone 4 needs a huge amount of pre-production before full development even begins. A lot has to be designed, planned, and put into motion early, including a large number of new assets. So this vote is about helping us lock in direction now, so the team can prepare properly for what comes next.
